name: Shirahama (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Shirahama town emblem in white: a disc pierced by a ring and a stylised triangular device.
history: Municipal flag of Shirahama, a town in Wakayama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 20 December 1950.

features.role: Shirahama town emblem — a disc pierced by a ring and a stylised triangular device
